QuestInfo.name: Shulynch's Training 2
QuestInfo.0: What's this? #b#p1092008##k looks surprised that you did so well on your first training exercise! Looks like she's preparing something harder, but YOU'LL be ready, won't you?
QuestInfo.1: More OctoPirates? Hmm, something seems different about them. Shulynch wants you to take down #r30#k of the tentacled buccaneers.
QuestInfo.2: You beat up more OctoPirates. #b#p1092008##k's got to respect you now!

0.0: Are you ready for something a bit harder?

yes.0: The next wave of monsters may look like OctoPirates, but don't underestimate them or you'll regret it! You're fighting for your life here.
yes.1: Talk to me once you're ready to enter the Training Room, then eliminate #r30 OctoPirates#k.

no.0: Don't waste my time. Piracy isn't for quitters!

1.0: Yes, that's how a Pirate should fight! You're a credit to the job.

yes.0: Remember, training never ends. When you think you're the best, someone else will show up to prove you wrong. As a Pirate, it's your duty to smash people like that in the face.

mob.0: You can't even handle #b30 OctoPirates#k? A shame.
